name: BOV Kompact EM Dual Port VR19 - Ecoboost + Ranger Raptor Bronco ALL
title: BOV Kompact EM Dual Port VR19 - Ecoboost + Ranger Raptor Bronco ALL
description:
The BOV Kompact EM Dual Port VR19 - Ecoboost + Ranger Raptor Bronco ALL provides direct plug-and-play upgrade capability over weak factory diverter valves, holding extreme boost pressure without leaking.

Technical Specifications:
• Brand & Engineering: Genuine Turbosmart high-performance motorsport hardware.
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined billet aluminum housing with hard-anodized finish.
• Porting: Dual-port configuration allows partial recirculation for ECU stability with atmospheric blow-off sound.
• Response: Fast-acting piston mechanism prevents compressor surge under sudden throttle lift.
